assets.scene: Close view of a simple homemade two-turn visual countdown on a tabletop during toy car play. MAIN focus: one horizontal cream card with EXACTLY TWO large outlined circular spaces; the left space is empty and the right still holds one removable mustard-yellow circular marker. An adult hand is lifting the removed yellow marker just away from the left circle toward a small shallow tray below, making one finished and one remaining unmistakable. A small child's hand rests next to a blue toy car on a short plain road mat beside the card. No whole people, no faces, no written numbers, no clock, no timer, no extra circles. Keep card, detached marker, tray and toy car clearly separated and fully framed. Natural hands.
